title: Aero-Palynological Survey — University of Uyo
description: Co-authored a 2021 research article documenting an aero-palynological survey of the University of Uyo campuses.
question: How can airborne pollen research be recorded and communicated in a form that other researchers can review?
design: This selected publication demonstrates participation in collaborative scientific writing and the communication of botanical research. The editorial preview here reproduces verified bibliographic details, not the original journal page or unverified research findings.
focus: Co-authored article published in a scientific journal
Clear research context and bibliographic attribution
Respecting the distinction between citation details and access to the full paper
No invented methodology, study results, or citation metrics
reflection: Scientific communication needs accurate attribution and evidence, not just an attractive paper preview.
coverAlt: Editorially typeset bibliographic preview of the 2021 coauthored University of Uyo aero-palynological survey publication, not a scan of the journal
